#   fmt      format template; %-prefixed one-letter field tokens
#            fields are allowed - a field absent from fmt must not be filled.
#   lfmt     latin-script alternative format where the country defines one.
#   require  one-letter fields that must be non-empty. Country is always required and never listed.
#   upper    one-letter fields upper-cased for postal presentation.
#   zip      AT COUNTRY LEVEL a Java-compatible regex matching all postal codes in the country;
#            BELOW country level the postal-code PREFIX expected in that region.
#   sub_keys '~'-separated child region keys; its presence is what indicates sub-region data exists.
#   The C++ parser (cpp/src/address_field_util.cc:38-48) knows only R S C D X Z A O N - not T F L.
# Absent values fall back to the live data/ZZ record: fmt=%N%n%O%n%A%n%C require=AC upper=C
